name: Mento Ghanaian Cedi
oneLiner: GHSm is Mento's Ghanaian cedi stablecoin on Celo, minted CDP-style against USDm collateral (Mento V3, a Liquity v2 fork).
collateral: Mento V3 Liquity-v2-style CDPs collateralized by USDm; USDm in turn is backed by the diversified Mento Reserve mix (sUSDS, CELO, EURC, USDC, USDT, axlEUROC, stETH, and smaller positions exposed via the Mento reserve dashboard).
pegMechanism: Mento V3 oracle-priced FX stablecoin minted by depositing USDm as CDP collateral and borrowing GHSm against it; user-set interest rates, Stability Pool liquidations, and Liquity-style redemptions support the GHSm peg, with circuit breakers and Mento reserve transparency on the upstream USDm leg.

notices.title: Peg grouped as Other
notices.message: GHS is not yet a first-class Pharos peg-currency enum, so GHSm is grouped under OTHER while the DefiLlama price and circulating-supply path admits the asset at runtime.
